_comment: SHARED, TRACKED expectation for Claude Code's engineering-awareness wiring. This file is NOT read by Claude Code. `.claude/settings.json` is gitignored (machine-local, personal — it also carries each engineer's own permission allowlist), so this file is what makes the wiring REPRODUCIBLE: .workstation/claude-awareness.ps1 -Apply merges these keys into the local settings.json, and -Verify reports what is missing. prepare.ps1 applies; doctor.ps1 verifies. Only governance-bearing keys live here — hooks, deny, ask. The `allow` list is deliberately absent: it is personal convenience, and shipping a broad allowlist to every machine is a security decision no script should make for an engineer.
